cards.name: You Meet in a Tavern
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Form a Party — Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal any number of creature cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
• Start a Brawl — Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.

You, Magic Playtester
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Choose target playtest card. Increase or decrease a number of your choice on it by one for as long as it remains on the stack or battlefield.
{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Reveal the top 8 cards of your library. Put each playtest card among them into your hand, and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
